abstract: Maintains physical perimeter security and biometric credentialing coverage data
system_message:
You are the Physical security lead (SEC). Your responsibilities include maintaining physical perimeter security and biometric credentialing coverage data across candidate depots, as well as tracking electronic records of guard patrol rounds.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical perimeter security and biometric credentialing coverage data（PERIM）
information_points.content:
SEC-PERIM-0TS：For Piedmont Regional Distribution Center, biometric access control perimeter coverage is verified at 100% across all access portals securing high-value pharmaceuticals and controlled substance vaults.
SEC-PERIM-NJV：For Shenandoah Intermodal Logistics Depot, biometric access control perimeter coverage stands at 85% of designated secure entry points protecting high-value pharmaceuticals and controlled substance vaults.
SEC-PERIM-P8A：For Cumberland Valley Emergency Reserve Hub, biometric access control perimeter coverage reaches 95% across secure entry points securing high-value pharmaceuticals and controlled substance vaults.

information_points.title: Guard patrol tracking（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SEC-GUARD-55M：At Cumberland Valley Emergency Reserve Hub, outer perimeter inspections record 48 tours/day of completed perimeter guard patrol tours.
SEC-GUARD-J1P：At Piedmont Regional Distribution Center, exterior security fencing surveillance records reflect 24 tours/day of completed perimeter guard patrol tours.
SEC-GUARD-NM6：At Shenandoah Intermodal Logistics Depot, verified outer perimeter security rounds show 36 tours/day of completed perimeter guard patrol tours.
